name: careshield-max
description: D2C health insurance buy journey — quote, medical declaration, instant bind & issue

scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run -w @careshield/api build && npm run -w @careshield/web build
scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -n contracts,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm:dev:contracts" "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run -w @careshield/api test && npm run -w @careshield/web test
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:contracts && npm run -w @careshield/api test:unit
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:contracts && dotenv -e .env -- npm run -w @careshield/api test:e2e
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run -w @careshield/api typecheck && npm run -w @careshield/web typecheck
